info.name: Test Data — Payroll Seeder
info.description:
Fabricates a month of attendance, holidays and leave so the payroll flow can be exercised without hand-building test data.

**Base URL:** `{{base_url}}/api/companies/{{company_id}}/test-data`

---

### ⚠️ Test utility

These endpoints **delete and rewrite attendance** for the target month. The router blocks itself when `NODE_ENV=production` unless `ALLOW_TEST_DATA_SEED=true` is set. Only set that on a throwaway environment.

### Typical loop

```
1. POST /test-data/attendance          seed August 2026
2. POST /payroll-runs                  open a run for 2026-08-01 → 2026-08-31
3. POST /payroll-runs/:id/generate     compute salaries
4. GET  /payroll-breakdown/:pid/breakdown
                                       check the day-by-day output
5. DELETE /test-data/attendance        tear down and repeat
```

### What to check in step 4

- The week-off between the two **half days** is `week_off`, paid, `is_sandwich: false` — this is the bug the seeder exists to catch
- The week-off between the two **absences** is `sandwich`, unpaid
- `comp_off` is paid and never sandwiched
- Days before a mid-month `joining_date` are `not_employed`, **not** `absent`
- `pay_fraction + deduct_fraction === 1` on every row
- `Σ payable_amount + Σ deduction_amount === gross_salary`

request.description:
**Role:** `isAdmin` · **blocked in production**

Fabricates a full month of attendance for the given employees so payroll can be tested end to end.

### What it creates

- **Attendance** for every day in the month — respecting each employee's shift week-offs and any company holiday
- **1–2 company holidays** mid-month (`create_holidays`)
- **Approved leave requests** — paid/unpaid × full/half day (`create_leaves`)

### Why it is not just random

Random attendance almost never produces the cases that actually break payroll. With `guarantee_scenarios: true` (the default) every employee's month is planted with:

| Scenario | What it tests |
|---|---|
| `half_day_around_week_off` | Half day either side of a weekend — must **NOT** sandwich |
| `absent_around_week_off` | Full absence either side — **IS** a sandwich, weekend unpaid |
| `mixed_sandwich_absent_side` / `_half_day_side` | Absent one side, half day the other — must **NOT** sandwich |
| `late_arrival` | 45 minutes late, still a full day |
| `overtime` | 3 hours over the shift |
| `comp_off` | Earned — stays paid, never sandwiched |
| `paid_full_day_leave` / `paid_half_day_leave` | Paid leave handling |
| `unpaid_full_day_leave` / `unpaid_half_day_leave` | Unpaid leave deduction |
| `plain_absence` | Ordinary absence |

Remaining days are filled randomly (~70% present, 12% overtime, 8% half day, 6% absent, 4% comp-off).

An employee whose `joining_date` falls mid-month gets no attendance before it — so `not_employed` proration can be tested too.

### Reproducibility

`seed` makes the month **deterministic** — the same seed always produces the same attendance. Omit it and a random one is generated **and returned**, so a payroll bug found once can be replayed exactly.

### Fields

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `employee_ids` | all active | Array of employee UUIDs |
| `month` / `year` | — | **required** |
| `seed` | random | Integer; returned in the response |
| `clear_existing` | `true` | Wipe the month first, so re-running is idempotent |
| `create_holidays` | `true` | Add 1–2 mid-month holidays |
| `create_leaves` | `true` | Add approved leave requests |
| `guarantee_scenarios` | `true` | Plant the cases above |

> ⚠️ **`clear_existing` deletes attendance for the target month** before writing. The router refuses to run when `NODE_ENV=production` unless `ALLOW_TEST_DATA_SEED=true` is set — only do that on a throwaway environment.

Seeded holidays and leaves are prefixed `[SEED]` so the teardown endpoint can find them without touching real records.

request.description:
**Role:** `isAdmin`

Tears down a seeded month:

- **all** attendance in the date range for the given employees
- leave requests whose reason starts with `[SEED]`
- holidays whose name starts with `[SEED]`

The `[SEED]` prefix is what keeps this from deleting real leave requests and holidays. Attendance has no such marker, so the whole month goes — which is why this endpoint is blocked in production.

Omit `employee_ids` to clear every active employee.

response.name: 200 OK

request.description:
**Role:** `isAdmin`

The scenarios a seeded month is guaranteed to contain, with a note on what each one is meant to prove. Useful as a checklist when reviewing the payroll breakdown.
